The '''1980–81 National Hurling League''' was the 50th season of the [[National Hurling League]] (NHL), an annual [[hurling]] competition for the [[GAA county teams]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.hoganstand.com/general/leagues/nhlrecords.aspx|title=National Hurling League Results 1925-2009|publisher=Hogan Stand|access-date=18 April 2011|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100805063526/http://www.hoganstand.com/general/leagues/nhlrecords.aspx|archive-date=2010-08-05|url-status=dead}}</ref><ref>{{cite book |last= Smith|first=Raymond |date=1999 |title=Complete Handbook of Gaelic Games |location=Dublin, Ireland |page=208 |isbn=0950175870}}</ref> It was won by {{GG|Cork|hurling}}.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://deiseach.wordpress.com/national-hurling-league-19801/|title=National Hurling League 1980/1|date=15 January 2011}}</ref>

==Division 1==
===Structure===

The National Hurling League's top division was divided into two groups - 1A and 1B. The top two teams in Division 1A advance to the semi-finals. The third- and fourth-placed teams in 1A, as well as the top two from 1B, play in the quarter-finals.
